muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يا أيها النبي﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle; «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); «ها» is for drawing attention; and «النبي» is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿لم تحرم ما أحل الله لك تبتغي مرضات أزواجك﴾: the lām is a preposition, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تحرم». «ما» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿أحل الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «لك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أحل﴾; the clause «تبتغي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تحرم»; and «مرضاة أزواجك» is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والله غفور رحيم﴾: «الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «غفور» is a khabar (predicate), and «رحيم» is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿قد فرض الله لكم تحلة أيمانكم﴾: «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «فرض الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فرض»; «تحلة» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «أيمانكم» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿والله مولاكم وهو العليم الحكيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مولاكم» is the khabar (predicate); «هو» is a mubtadaʾ, «العليم» is a first khabar, and «الحكيم» is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وإذ أسر النبي إلى بعض أزواجه حديثا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر» (remember); the clause ﴿أسر النبي﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «حديثًا» is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فلما نبأت به وأظهره الله عليه عرف بعضه وأعرض عن بعض﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لما» is an adverb in the sense of «حين» (when), or a linking [particle] containing the meaning of condition; the clause «نبأت» is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it. «نبأت» in the verse is transitive to two [objects], the first of which is omitted, and the second is made genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. «نبأت به غيرها» (she informed another woman of it). «وأظهره»: the wāw is a conjunction, «أظهره» is a verb and its object, and «الله» is the fāʿil (agent); «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أظهره﴾. The clause «عرف» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; «بعضه» is a mafʿūl bihi; «أعرض» is conjoined to «عرف»; «عن بعض» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعرض﴾; and the second object of «عرف» is omitted, i.e. «عرفها بعض ما فعلت» (he made her know part of what she had done).
﴿فلما نبأها به قالت من أنبأك هذا قال نبأني العليم الخبير﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لما» is a temporal adverb (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or a linking [particle] containing the meaning of condition in any case; «نبأها» is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause «قالت» has no grammatical position; «من» is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «أنبأك» is the khabar (predicate), the kāf being the first object and «هذا» the second object; «قال» is a past verb; the clause «نبأني العليم الخبير» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); «العليم» is the fāʿil of «نبأني», and «الخبير» is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿إن تتوبا إلى الله فقد صغت قلوبكما﴾: «إن» is conditional; «تتوبا» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its being jussive (majzūm) being the dropping of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil (agent); «إلى الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تتوبا﴾; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: «يتب عليكما» (He will turn to you in forgiveness). The fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «صغت», i.e. inclined, is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; and «قلوبكما» is the fāʿil of «صغت».
﴿وإن تظاهرا عليه فإن الله هو مولاه وجبريل وصالح المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن» is conditional; «تظاهرا» is the protasis, the sign of its being jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil; «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تظاهرا﴾; the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: «يجد ناصرًا» (he will find a helper). The fāʾ is causal; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun; «هو» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl); and «مولاه» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن». «جبريل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «صالح المؤمنين» is conjoined to «جبريل». It has also been said: «جبريل» and «صالح المؤمنين» are both conjoined to the position of «إن» and its noun, so that the khabar of them all is «مولاه»; on the view that it is a mubtadaʾ, the khabar is His saying: «ظهير».
﴿والملائكة بعد ذلك ظهير﴾: «الملائكة» is conjoined to what precedes; or: a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is «ظهير».

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿عسى ربه إن طلقكن أن يبدله أزواجا خيرا منكن﴾: «عسى» is a past verb, one of the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ), and «ربه» is its noun; «إن» is conditional; «طلقكن» is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «أن» is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; «يبدله» is an imperfect verb made accusative (manṣūb) by «أن», and «أن» together with what falls within its scope is the khabar (predicate) of «عسى»; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. «فعسى» (then it may be). «أزواجًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi, «خيرًا» is an adjective (ṣifa), and «منكن» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خيرًا﴾.
﴿مسلمات مؤمنات قانتات تائبات عابدات سائحات ثيبات وأبكارا﴾: «مسلمات» is a second naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أزواجًا﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), or accusative by way of specification (ikhtiṣāṣ); and what follows it are multiple adjectives.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارًا وقودها الناس والحجارة﴾: «قوا» is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; «أنفسكم» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أهليكم» is conjoined to «أنفسكم», the sign of its being accusative being the yāʾ, because it is attached (mulḥaq) to the sound masculine plural; «نارًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi; «وقودها» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «الناس» the khabar (predicate), or the reverse; «الحجارة» is conjoined to «النار» «[Translator's note: so in the source; it is conjoined to «الناس».]»; and the clause «وقودها الناس» is an adjective of ﴿نارًا﴾.
﴿عليها ملائكة غلاظ شداد لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم ويفعلون ما يؤمرون﴾: the clause is a second adjective of ﴿نارًا﴾. «عليها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; «ملائكة» is a postponed mubtadaʾ; «غلاظ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ملائكة», and «شداد» is a second naʿt. «لا» is negating; «يعصون الله» is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); «أمرهم» is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from ﴿الله﴾, in the accusative, or it is accusative by removal of the preposition. The clause ﴿أمرهم﴾ is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. «ويفعلون»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يفعلون» is an imperfect verb in the nominative and its fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, a mafʿūl bihi; the clause «يؤمرون» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the referring pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. «به».

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين كفروا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; «كفروا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تعتذروا اليوم إنما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون﴾: «لا» is prohibitive; «تعتذروا» is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا»; «اليوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعتذروا﴾; and the clause is the object of an omitted saying, i.e. that is said to them upon entering the Fire. «إنما» is [«إنّ»] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [«ما»] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); «تجزون» is an imperfect verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «ما» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «كنتم» is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause «تعملون» is the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم».

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle; «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿توبوا إلى الله توبة نصوحا﴾: «توبوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; «إلى الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿توبوا﴾; «توبة» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «نصوحًا» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿توبة﴾.
﴿عسى ربكم أن يكفر عنكم سيئاتكم﴾: «عسى» is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb, one of the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ), and «ربكم» is its noun; «أن» together with what falls within its scope is in the place of an accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «عسى»; «عنكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يكفر﴾; and «سيئاتكم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ويدخلكم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يدخلكم» is conjoined to «يكفر», and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi; «جنات» is a second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); the clause «تجري» is a naʿt of ﴿جنات﴾; «من تحتها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجري﴾; and «الأنهار» is the fāʿil of «تجري».
﴿يوم لا يخزي الله النبي﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿يدخلكم﴾; ﴿لا﴾ is negating; ﴿يخزي الله﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يخزي﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; and ﴿النبي﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والذين آمنوا معه نورهم يسعى بين أيديهم وبأيمانهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «الذين» is a relative noun in the position of an accusative, conjoined to «النبي»; «نورهم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يسعى» is the khabar; the clause ﴿نورهم يسعى﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿النبي والذين آمنوا معه﴾. Or the wāw is resumptive, the clause after it being resumptive with no grammatical position, «الذين» being a mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿نورهم يسعى﴾ its khabar. ﴿بين﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿يسعى﴾, and «أيديهم» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «بأيمانهم» is conjoined to the adverb, attached to what it is attached to.
﴿يقولون ربنا أتمم لنا نورنا﴾: the clause is circumstantial, in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl from ﴿النبي والذين آمنوا معه﴾. «ربنا» is the one addressed, a muḍāf; «أتمم» is a verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (You); ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أتمم»; «نورنا» is the object of «أتمم»; and the clause ﴿ربنا أتمم لنا نورنا﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
﴿واغفر لنا﴾: «اغفر» is a verb of supplication, indeclinable on sukūn, and the fāʿil is «أنت»; «لنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اغفر﴾; and the clause ﴿اغفر لنا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أتمم لنا﴾ within the scope of the saying.
﴿إنك على كل شيء قدير﴾: ﴿إنك﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the kāf is its noun; ﴿على كل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قدير﴾; ﴿شيء﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿قدير﴾ is the khabar of «إن», in the nominative (marfūʿ).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿يا أيها النبي﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); «ها» is for drawing attention; and «النبي» is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿جاهد الكفار والمنافقين واغلظ عليهم﴾: «جاهد» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (you); «الكفار» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «المنافقين» is conjoined to «الكفار»; «اغلظ» is an imperative verb conjoined to «جاهد»; and «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اغلظ﴾.
﴿ومأواهم جهنم وبئس المصير﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); «مأواهم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «جهنم» is the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿ومأواهم جهنم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «بئس» is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; «المصير» is the fāʿil; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e.: «هي» (it).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿ضرب الله مثلا للذين كفروا امرأة نوح وامرأة لوط﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. «ضرب الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «مثلًا» is a fronted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām and what it puts in the genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿مثلًا﴾; «امرأة نوح» is the first mafʿūl bihi; and «امرأة لوط» is conjoined to «امرأة نوح».
﴿كانتا تحت عبدين من عبادنا صالحين فخانتاهما﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; the alif is the noun of «كان»; «تحت عبدين»: the adverb is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «من عبادنا» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عبدين﴾; «فخانتاهما» is conjoined, and it is a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فلم يغنيا عنهما من الله شيئا وقيل ادخلا النار مع الداخلين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لم» is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive; «يغنيا» is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by «لم», the sign of its being jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil; «عنهما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغنيا﴾; «من الله»: «من» is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يغنيا﴾; «شيئًا» stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or it is a mafʿūl bihi. «قيل» is conjoined to what precedes, and it is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive); the clause «ادخلا» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); «النار» is a mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); and «مع الداخلين» is an adverb attached to ﴿ادخلا﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿وضرب الله مثلا للذين آمنوا امرأت فرعون﴾: «ضرب الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «مثلًا» is a fronted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām and what it puts in the genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿مثلا﴾; and «امرأة فرعون» is the first mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إذ قالت رب ابن لي عندك بيتا في الجنة﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿ضرب﴾, even though the striking [of the parable] appears later, or attached to «المثَل» (the parable); the clause ﴿قالت﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «رب» is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, from which the vocative particle has been omitted; «ابنِ» is a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; «لي» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ابنِ﴾; «عندك» is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the first-person pronoun, or from ﴿بيتًا﴾ because it precedes it; and «في الجنة» is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) or a badal (substitute) for His saying «عندك», or [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to «ابنِ».
﴿ونجني من فرعون وعمله ونجني من القوم الظالمين﴾: «نجني» is conjoined to «ابنِ»; «من فرعون» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجني﴾; «عمله» is conjoined; «من القوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجني﴾; and «الظالمين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿القوم﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ومريم ابنت عمران التي أحصنت فرجها﴾: «مريم» is conjoined to «امرأة فرعون»; «ابنة» is a badal (substitute) of, or a naʿt (adjective) of, ﴿مريم﴾; «عمران» is a muḍāf «[Translator's note: so in the source; «عمران» is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).]» and is made genitive by the fatḥa, because it is a diptote on account of being a proper name and having the added alif and nūn; ﴿التي﴾ is a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt of ﴿مريم﴾; and the clause ﴿أحصنت فرجها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿فنفخنا فيه من روحنا﴾: «فنفخنا» is conjoined to «أحصنت»; «فيه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نفخنا﴾; «من روحنا» is an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. «روحًا من روحنا» (a spirit of Our spirit); and «من» is partitive (tabʿīḍ).
﴿وصدقت بكلمات ربها وكتبه﴾: «صدقت» is conjoined to an omitted [verb], implied in a way suited to the context, i.e. «حملت بعيسى وصدقت» (she conceived ʿĪsā and believed); «بكلمات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿صدقت﴾; «ربها» is a muḍāf ilayhi; and «كتبه» is conjoined to «كلمات».
﴿وكانت من القانتين﴾: «كانت» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun being latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هي» (she); «من القانتين» is the khabar (predicate); and «من» is for the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya); or: for partition, the masculine being used by way of predominance (taghlīb).
